subject: pe
title: Cardio Fitness: Testing
welcome_lead: Want proof you're getting fitter? Test, train, test again.
meta_desc: KS3 PE: bleep test, Cooper test, recovery rate.
final_note: Numbers don't lie — track your progress.

concepts.def: How far you run in 12 minutes.
How fast HR drops after exercise.

walkthroughs.body_html: The bleep test uses 20-metre shuttles between beeps that speed up each level. Higher levels = better cardio.
Run as far as you can in 12 minutes on a track. Distance gives a score for cardio fitness.
Fitter people's heart rate drops faster after stopping. A good recovery rate is a sign of cardio improvements.

options: Air left in the lungs after maximum exhalation.
The maximum air your lungs can hold.
Volume of air inhaled or exhaled in one normal breath at rest.
